message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13 inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no-boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz can (or 2 cups) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 1 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | To taste |
| | Italian seasoning or dried basil | 1 tsp |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | Pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | A handful |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ¼ cup |
| | Salt, pepper | To taste |
| | Fresh parsley or basil | A handful |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella cheese | 2–3 cups |
| **Parmesan topping** | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup |
| **Optional extras** | Spinach (fresh or frozen, sautéed) | 2 cups |
| | Mushrooms, sliced | 1 cup |
| | Bell pepper, diced | 1 cup |

**Quick notes:**
- If you’re using regular lasagna sheets, boil them until al dente before layering.
- For a vegetarian version, replace the meat sauce with a hearty vegetable sauce (e.g., sautéed zucchini, eggplant, bell peppers, and mushrooms).
- Feel free to add a splash of white wine to the meat sauce for extra depth.

Enjoy building your lasagna!
